# ARDN Cloud Solutions

> ARDN Cloud Solutions is a US-based custom AI app development company. We design, build, deploy, and operate bespoke AI applications for one predictable monthly fee — production-ready in 2–6 weeks via our proprietary AI Forge Framework. Backed by 30+ years of enterprise software experience, we also offer a focused suite of cloud products and consulting for teams that run on Salesforce. New customers get the one-time custom AI build free and pay only the monthly subscription.

## Products & Services

- [AI Forge](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-forge): Custom AI applications built and run for you. Our team designs, builds, hosts, and continuously improves bespoke AI apps for one monthly subscription — live in 2–6 weeks. New customers get the one-time custom build free and pay only the monthly subscription.
- [Custom AI App Development](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-app-development): How we build and operate custom AI applications for companies across the US — discovery to production in 2–6 weeks, then hosted and iterated under one monthly fee.
- [AI for Insurance](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-for-insurance): Custom AI for carriers and agencies — claims triage, underwriting support, document processing, and self-service, with humans in the loop on regulated decisions.
- [AI for Hospitality](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-for-hospitality): Custom AI for hotels, resorts, and hospitality groups — 24/7 guest concierge, booking automation, and service routing across every channel.
- [AI for Membership Organizations](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-for-membership-organizations): Custom AI for YMCAs, gyms, studios, clubs, and associations — onboarding, renewals, failed-payment recovery, and retention early-warning.
- [Storefronts](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/storefronts): Salesforce-native ecommerce — products, memberships, subscriptions, events, and ticketing without leaving Salesforce.
- [Salesforce Payments](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/salesforce-payments): Quote-to-cash inside Salesforce — branded checkout, real-time status, and automated reconciliation.
- [License Guard](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/license-guard): Salesforce-native tool that detects and reclaims unused Salesforce licenses, typically paying back its annual cost within a quarter.
- [AI-Powered Support (ReplyCX)](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/ai-powered-support): No-code AI agents that automate roughly 70% of routine customer queries across WhatsApp, email, live chat, and social — in one inbox.
- [Membership Management](https://ardncloudsolutions.com/membership-management): A flexible membership platform for gyms, YMCAs, studios, clubs, and associations — recurring billing, class scheduling, attendance, and a branded member portal.

- Location: Orlando, Florida, USA. Serves clients across the United States and globally (remote-friendly).
